memos.scout:
I can't make a real case for buying GOIF here, and I'd recommend skipping it.

The brief shows a bundled launch: the top 3 buyers hold 100% of the curve, and in the first two minutes after graduation, 20 buyers took 5,022 SOL while the top 5 buyers account for 99.96% of that volume with a sell-to-buy ratio near zero. That is an operator-backed pattern with supply concentrated in a few wallets, and a launch bot was present.

The 30-minute return of roughly 3,900x and a $193M market cap on a coin 30 minutes old are signs of manufactured price action, not organic demand. The last 15 minutes show net inflow of 137 SOL, but with only 31 buyers and 16 sellers, that flow is likely dominated by the same concentrated wallets. Nothing in the brief shows broad holders who would absorb a sell.

The bright spot is the small 0.06% drawdown from the 30-minute high, but that just means no one has sold into it yet. With a bundle controlling the curve, one exit by a top holder could erase the position within the 30-second execution lag. The base rates give operator-backed coins roughly break-even odds before fees, and fees of 1.4-5.1% push the expectation negative.

Verdict: no honest case for buyin

Skip.
